issue.title: Need new test: Verify packets do not egress with IP header checksum 0xffff

failure.body:
1. IP header checksum calculated as 0xffff and sent as 0xffff, should pass through.
2. IP header checksum calculated as 0, and sent as 0, should pass through.
3. IP header checksum calculated as 0, but sent as 0xffff:
Broadcom ASIC known tolerate this packet and let it go.
Mellanox ASIC known drop this packet and we need to see drop counter increase.
4. Construct a packet to be forwarded with checksum 0. (TTL -1 making checksum 0) and check the forwarded packet the checksum is 0.
